notes.title: Minor Update 7/1/24
notes.notes: This is a minor update meant to (hopefully) fix faulty controls for our Oculus Rift users.

notes.title: Update (6/25/24): Mitt Invaders
notes.notes:
It's about time for another update!
The biggest thing we bring to you is a new minigame called 'Mitt Invaders.' It is accessible via the arcade cabinet in the Engine Room gym. Let us know what your highscore is!
We also include numerous bug fixes, such as bout data no longer appearing on the leaderboards.
Want to chat with the devs or fellow boxers? Join our Discord community here! [url=https://discord.gg/t8NsuFfWSm]https://discord.gg/t8NsuFfWSm[/url]

Have fun and keep earning those gains!

notes.title: Small Update (4/10/24): USA Boxing Gym Mural
notes.notes:
This update is to show off a mural done by the artist Gabe Gault depicting a qualified Olympian boxer, Morelle McCane. On either side of the mural, you can see the artist's bio as well as a list of boxers from the US that have qualified for the Olympics. (This mural is only in the USA Boxing Gym.)

To accomodate this mural, the leaderboards, gym selection whiteboard, and bout whiteboard have been moved. The bout whiteboard is more to the right of where it was before and the leaderboard and gym selection whiteboards are on the wall to the right of the mural (the wall with the garage doors).

notes.title: Update 4/4/24: Sparring Mode
notes.notes:
Another month, another update is finally here- and we're happy to tell you that one of our more requested features, sparring mode, is now in the game! In this mode, you can fight the AI boxer without worrying about being knocked down, so you can work on your boxing technique. (Damage indicators still exist in this mode, to tell you when you might need to work on defending!)
To turn on sparring mode, simply navigate to the custom bout settings on the bout selection whiteboard and continue until you see the 'Sparring Mode' toggle.

Other changes in this update include (but are not necessarily limited to):
[list]
[*] Round customization settings (finally you can fight the AI for 12 rounds!)
[*] Bug fixes for Fists of Fury
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (3/5/24)
notes.notes:
Things have been pretty quiet here at Engine Room VR lately, so this patch does not have any major changes. It does contain a few minor bug fixes (such as fixing left-handed mode in Fists of Fury) and a few polishes (such as moving the gym selection UI onto a whiteboard).

Hope you all continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Hotfix 1/18/24
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused major UI issues. Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update 12/15/23: An Early Christmas Present
notes.notes:
Merry Friday! Today we bring you some more updates to keep you busy during the holidays!
[list]
[*] Added 'Coach Sloan Says' minigame to both gyms
[*] Leaderboards are now on whiteboards rather than UI panels
[*] Christmas is almost here- boxers will wear Christmas-themed hats from December 18th-30th
[*] Quit button in pause menu is now immediately visible
[*] Whiteboard interaction has been improved (haptics, button animations, etc)
[/list]
... and more!


In addition, to keep our players informed, we would like to share that in a future build, we will begin using Unity Analytics within the project. The data we will collect is purely to see where our users are spending their time in the game and to make improvements based on that. Any data collected via Analytics is 100% anonymous and we can in no way identify a player with the data collected. When that update rolls out, we will give all our players the ability to opt-out/delete any data collected. We have updated our Privacy Policy in light of this coming change, you can read it here: [url=https://goldenglovesvr.com/privacy-policy/]https://goldenglovesvr.com/privacy-policy/[/url]
*Please note that as of right now, no data or personal information of any kind has been collected at all.

notes.title: Update 11/20: Customizable AI, New Boxers, and more!
notes.notes:
With this build, we have a few new features that we're excited to roll out!
[list]
[*] Customizable AI is in the game! Some of the features you can customize include damage, health, block chance, and more. More customizability will be added in the future.
[*] Two new boxers, Miguel and Cassie, have been added to the roster!
[*] A new venue, the Street venue, has been added!
[*] We have replaced the gym bout UI with an interactable whiteboard- and more will come in the future!
[*] We are celebrating Thanksgiving by adding some holiday cheer to Fists of Fury! To see these additions, go into the pause menu and select 'Enable Holiday Assets' underneath the Game settings.
[*] Commentary is off by default now
[*] Plus some bug fixes...
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Small Patch (11/5/2023)
notes.notes: This patch fixes an issue with the control scheme image not showing up correctly in the pause menu.

notes.title: Update 10/20/23: Halloween!
notes.notes:
It's almost time for the spookiest day of the year, and we here at Golden Gloves VR are celebrating it as well! We've released an update full of new content, just in time for Halloween!
Changes include:
[list]
[*] We now have a setting to enable holiday assets! This means that during holidays (Halloween, Christmas, etc), if the setting is on, you may see holiday-themed textures, models, etc. This setting can be found under the 'Game' section of the pause menu.
[*] Halloween assets are now in the game! These will be visible from Oct. 20th-Nov. 1st (if 'enable holiday assets' is switched on). Some things to look out for include mask-wearing boxers and special objects in the Fists of Fury minigame.
[*] Added a setting to change glove color
[*] Certain objects now change textures based on saved gym (including bout boxing rings and Fists of Fury mitts). (Note that holiday textures override saved gym textures.)
[*] Dingle and slip bags have been added!
[*] Added 'bag switcher' to gyms that allows you to swap out special bags (such as the cobra bag and dingle bag)
[*] Fists of Fury mitts now give you points based on how closely you hit the center dot
[/list]

notes.title: Base Content Update 9/8/2023: Fists of Fury Minigame Update
notes.notes:
Today, we're bringing you an update for the Fists of Fury minigame!
Here's what we changed:
[list]
[*] A tutorial to show you how to play the game has been added. It can be turned on and off with a toggle on the control panel for the game
[*] "R" and "L" characters on the mitts so that players can learn which hands they need to punch with.
[*] Difficulty slider with options for Novice, Open, Pro, and Endless modes! The first version of the minigame was the Novice setting!
[*] Streaks! The higher your streak gets the more points you'll get per punch! Streaks can be lost by missing a mitt or taking damage. We will also save your highest streak score now too.
[*] The high score that is saved is the highest out of all of the modes now.
[*] Leaderboard integration for high score and highest streak score!
[*] We have disabled pausing while in the minigame so that you can't cheat and take breaks anymore.
[*] Lives have also been capped! You can no longer get more than 3 lives.
[/list]
We're hoping to see you on the leaderboards! The office high score is 100,778- can you beat it?

Plus, we fixed a bug that prevented the controls from appearing correctly on the pause menu.

notes.title: Hotfix 8/30/23
notes.notes: Fixed a bug wherein the mitts for the Fist of Fury minigame in the Engine Room Gym were not correctly set. Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update Notes (8/30/23): Minigames & More!
notes.notes:
This update we're excited to reveal some of the things that we've been working on, one of which being minigames! Read on to see all that we've added/changed:
[list]
[*] Added a few minigames to the gyms (Fists of Fury (standalone), Heavy Bag (speed taps and highest damage), Speed Bag & Double End Bag (punch streaks))
[*] Fixed a bug where the additional bout commentary would start off disabled
[*] Added Fitness Tracker UI panel in the gym and calorie burn tracker with daily burn goals
[*] Re-added the hand wrap customizer UI to the game, it can be found in the Pause Room on the right of the Pause Menu UI
[*] Fixed a bug where the female boxers weren't using the updated systems and animations
[/list]

notes.title: Reupload of previous build + leaderboard UI bug fix
notes.notes: Reuploaded the build since the previous one didnt work and fixed a bug with the leaderboard UI panels in the gyms.

notes.title: 7/18/23 Update
notes.notes:
Change Log:
⦁ Body shots were made slightly easier to block (More tuning is needed for it to be more accurate)
⦁ Slipping punches now plays whoosh sounds if the punch passes by close to the ear
⦁ Cobra bag has been added to the game
⦁ The system that handles punches and glove movement has been tweaked slightly so that the glove gets caught on the AI less and the damage should now be consistent across headsets.

Currently In Work:
⦁ Dodging and slipping punches required the IK system to be changed in a large way so we are currently working on that. Once that is done we will need to go back and tune all of the animations so they work with the new IK system better
⦁ Punch Mechanics are still being tweaked and worked on
⦁ The web browser is still very clunky and requires more work before we can put it in the game

Up Next:
⦁ Vignette filter adjustable size slider for the people who want the vignette but want it to cover a different percentage of the screen
⦁ Disable unnecessary audio button during bouts
⦁ Add new Dingle punching bag to the gym

notes.title: Update 4/3/2023 and Patch 4/5/2023
notes.notes:
Change Log (4/3/2023):
 - Female Career Track is now in! We are starting it off with 3 boxers (Allie, Tiffany, and Savannah). Switching career tracks is as easy as flipping a switch above the bout selection UI panel in the gym.
 - A new bout venue and training gym are in the game now too! You can now fight in our Alleyway venue and train in our recreation of the USA Boxing Gym located in Colorado Springs!
 - The USA Boxing Gym has been set as the default gym for now. If you want to change back to the old gym scene you can do that by interacting with the Gym Selection panel found next to the bout selection panel in the gym. There are also instructions there to help you learn how to select the correct gym for you!
 - We have fixed bouts 4-10 and tuned their stats and available animations to make them harder and more unique. No more bulldozing your way through career mode!
 - Quick Play buttons have been added to the Calibration Scene. Once you calibrate your height for the first time, and set the toggle "Skip Calibration" in the pause room under the Game tab, these buttons become available the next time you load in.
 - New audio lines have been added and a female audio grouping has been added for the Female Career Track (This group currently has a lot less audio than the male track. We are working to correct this asap)

Patch Notes (4/5/2023):
 - Additional changes for boxers from bouts 4-10 to make them harder and behave more uniquely.
 - Fixed lighting in the new USA Boxing Gym.
 - Fixed female boxer outfits in the calibration scene so they are true to the order they are fought in career mode.
 - Applied boxer changes to female career track!

notes.title: Small Update 2/28/23
notes.notes:
Change log 2/28/23:
 - Fixed the bug that would cause the boxer in the calibration scene to not appear and would mess up the career mode UI panel.
 - Added a new piece of training equipment to the gym scene! The Wall Bag can be found to the left of the speed bags and can be used to train your hooks and uppercuts!
 - Optimized the Calibration Scene because it was using up a lot of GPU resources.
 - Updated the Score Cards at the end of bouts so it doesn't have text sizing issues and shows the players stats first instead of the bout scores.
 - Rotation is now allowed during bouts if Orbital Movement is enabled.
 - Bout system now properly differentiates between a TKO (3 Knockdowns in same round) and a KO. It will still take 3 Knockdowns throughout the entire bout to KO the boxers.
 - Optimized the lightmaps to save performance and storage.
